extraction.Name: Virginia Miller
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded Febr. 20, 1918 but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: mortgaged February 10, 1918 for $1500.00; second mortgage December 21, 1922 for $2000.00; third mortgage executed November 28, 1925 for $800.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the 1927 and prior taxes have been paid; but on March 6, 1929 the 1928 taxes amounting to $82.72 had not been paid
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612827 issued; southwest quarter of section 2, township 95, range 71; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 14, 1918
